bullets.text: The public works department is considering a fresh detailed project report and new tenders for the Thiruvanmiyur to Uthandi elevated corridor along ECR, and the office should monitor progress.
A new five-screen PVR multiplex with 4K laser projection is scheduled to open at XB Mall in Velachery in December 2026, boosting local entertainment facilities.
Collector Kavitha announced a special ration card grievance redressal camp across nine taluk supply offices in Thiruvallur district today, and the office should oversee implementation.
Avadi city police arrested two men from Kerala and seized 10 kg of ganja near Poonamallee, prompting the office to support stricter anti-narcotics enforcement.
Farmers in Ponneri urged officials during a grievance meeting to set up a green gram procurement centre, and the office should follow up on this demand.
The Tamil Nadu department of industries convened a roundtable with realty developers to fast-track Global Capability Centre corridors, and the office should support this initiative.
A Chennai techie was cheated of 27 lakh rupees by a fraudster using AI-altered images on a dating app, highlighting the need for enhanced cybercrime awareness.
MeitY is probing apps over data collection practices and worker videos used for AI training, and the office should monitor regulatory updates on privacy.
A police case was registered against a TVK functionary following a complaint of sexual harassment by a female administrator, and the office should watch legal developments.
Minister Marie Wilson dismissed rumors regarding signatures being collected during a TVK MLA meeting as baseless, and the office should note the clarification.
